mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD_HASH, NICKNAME, ROLE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_USERS.NEXTVAL, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{role}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD_HASH, NICKNAME, ROLE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, DELETED_AT FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID=#{userId}
SELECT USER_ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD_HASH, NICKNAME, ROLE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, DELETED_AT FROM USERS WHERE EMAIL=#{email}
